encode_keypoints: encode keypoint coordinates in shape (N, K, D) to a specific representation like heatmap
decode_keypoints: decode an encoded keypoint representation back to coordinates and visibility arrays
batch_decode_keypoints: decode a batch of encoded keypoint representations into lists of coordinates and visibility
check_batch_decoding_support: check whether a keypoint codec subclass supports batch decoding via the support_batch_decoding property
subclass_BaseKeypointCodec: create a subclass of BaseKeypointCodec that implements encode and decode methods for custom keypoint representations
